svg.title: Annotated portrait example with supplied luminance readings
svg.desc: The supplied portrait sample is annotated with five approximate target regions: A 67, B 165, C 77, D 415 and E 65 cd/m². Course-note and photo timestamps differ, so the readings illustrate target selection rather than a validated calibration.

g.text: 05 / MATCH THE METER READING TO THE SAME IMAGE REGION
Photo EXIF: 4:45:53 pm; timing is unverified.
They are not a validated calibration for this frame.
Source: 3X6A2043.JPG and the accompanying portrait measurement sheet. Marker positions are approximate.
